strategy.thesis: Global early-stage venture fund backing founders building the future of blockchain and cryptocurrency, with deep focus on Web3 infrastructure, finance, gaming and entertainment. Acts as both investor and ecosystem builder.

summary.en: Hashed is South Korea's most prominent blockchain-focused venture firm and ecosystem builder, founded in 2017 by Simon Seojoon Kim and partners. Headquartered in Seoul with offices in San Francisco, Singapore and Abu Dhabi, it runs subsidiaries including Hashed Ventures (its VC fund arm), Hashed Emergent (emerging markets), UNOPND (Web3 incubation) and KODA (institutional custody, with KB Kookmin Bank and Haechi Labs).

It runs Hashed Venture Fund I (~KRW 120B / $120M, 2020, 100% private capital from LPs including Naver and Krafton), Fund II (~KRW 240B / $200M, 2021) targeting Web3 adoption across metaverse, gaming, NFTs and open finance, and Fund III (2024, with strategic investment from SMBC Nikko Securities).

summary.en: Dunamu & Partners is the investment subsidiary of Dunamu, operator of Upbit (handles >80% of Korean virtual-asset trading). Founded March 2018, it announced a three-year ~KRW 100 billion (~$84M) plan to invest in the blockchain industry, having deployed >KRW 55 billion (~$46M) across 26 companies by May 2019. It also set up a KRW 100 billion blockchain-game fund with Neptune.

As of October 2025 it was reported to be in court rehabilitation (회생절차), with its co-CEOs having faced legal proceedings tied to crypto-related cases.

strategy.thesis: Thesis-driven multi-strategy crypto fund founded 2016. Acts as a bridge for global Web3 projects entering Korea and supports Korean-origin projects in the Solana and Polkadot ecosystems, DeFi and NFTs.

summary.en: ROK Capital is a Korea-based, thesis-driven multi-strategy crypto fund founded in 2016, focused on the Solana and Polkadot ecosystems, DeFi and NFTs. In 2021 it partnered with the Solana Foundation to launch a fund of up to $20M to develop the Solana ecosystem in Korea. Check sizes range from $1M to $20M; early portfolio includes Serum, Mercurial Finance, Synthetify and Parrot.

summary.en: Blocore is a Seoul-based (with Singapore presence) entrepreneurship-driven Web3 investment firm founded in 2018 by James Lim (Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia, ex-TGV founding partner). It invests across Web3 gaming, social, IP and technology, has made 50+ investments across 40 companies, and counts The Sandbox, Animoca Brands and Kong Studios among its unicorn portfolio. It also builds in-house games/IP (Moonfrost, Zanmang LOOPY) and partnered with Animoca Ventures.

It has invested in 30+ global projects, focusing on early-stage crypto companies and Korean market entry for global Web3 projects, and operates validator services. It raised ~$3.38M with investors including SV Investment and KB Investment.
